“夏满，你竟然还有脸回来，你怎么就这么不要脸呢？我要是你，这辈子就待在国外，打死也不回来，免得回来丢人现眼，败坏夏家的名声。”

时笙正准备往里面走的时候，听到夏满的名字，顿了顿，回头看去。

一个打扮靓丽的女人堵在门口，那个女人就站在她几步远的地方，而夏满被她堵在门口。

夏满眸光微沉，面色冷淡的道：“我和夏家没关系。”

夏萱眉眼间都染上了讥讽，“哟，这么硬气啊，不是又找到什么靠山了吧？也是，你现在，能靠的也就是那个身子了……”

“啪！”

夏萱的身子一歪，正好撞到时笙身上，时笙身子踉跄了下，撞到旁边的花盆，花盆是四方形，有棱有角，顶得她腰间一阵钝痛。

老子只是看个戏，怎么也能被连累啊操！

还有这个陆清韵，拉她一把要死啊！

陆清韵刚才就站在她旁边，明明只需要顺手扶她一下，就能让她稳住身子，可这货倒好，环着手，笑得跟朵花儿似的，眼睁睁的看着她撞到花盆上。

“没事吧。”一双手将她扶住，时笙微微皱眉，抬头看向手的主人。

——席墨。

“阿墨，你竟然让人打我？我做错什么了？”夏萱捂着脸，满脸委屈的看向席墨，而刚才动手的人还站在夏萱旁边，是席墨的助理。

席墨将时笙扶起来，单手环过她的腰，声音淡漠，“你挡着我女朋友了。”

时笙：“……”

这理由也太不走心了！

你大爷的，席墨这男人明明是替夏满鸣不平，偏偏要把仇恨值往她身上拉。

你想护着心头白月光朱砂痣，没问题！

可是把仇恨值往她身上拉，那就是个禽兽了！

夏萱瞳孔放大，满脸的不可置信，如刀子一般的眼神戳向时笙，指着她质问，“她……她是谁？”

女朋友？阿墨哪里来的女朋友？一定是这个女人勾引阿墨的！

时笙反感席墨碰自己，伸手就抓住陆清韵，借力将自己从席墨怀中拉了出去，靠着陆清韵的胳膊，“席总，饭可以乱吃，话不能乱说，我和你清清白白的，你这么毁我名誉，可不太好。”

今天得和席墨闹翻了。

"Xia Man, you actually have the nerve to come back. Why are you so shameless? If I were you, I would stay abroad for the rest of my life and never come back even to death, lest I come back and be embarrassed and ruin the Xia family's reputation."

When Shi Sheng was about to walk inside, he paused and looked back when he heard Xia Man's name.

A beautifully dressed woman blocked the door. The woman was standing a few steps away from her, and Xia Man was blocked by her.

Xia Man's eyes darkened slightly and he said coldly, "I have nothing to do with the Xia family."

Xia Xuan's eyebrows were filled with sarcasm, "Oh, you are so tough, haven't you found some support again? That's right, now, that's the only one you can rely on..."

"Crack!"

Xia Xuan's body tilted and she bumped into Shi Sheng. Shi Sheng stumbled and hit the flowerpot next to her. The flowerpot was square in shape and had edges and corners, which caused a dull pain in her waist.

I was just watching a show, how could I be implicated? Damn it!

And this Lu Qingyun, drag her to death!

Lu Qingyun was standing next to her just now. She obviously only needed to help her to stabilize her body, but this guy was so good. He folded his arms and smiled like a flower, watching her bump into the flower pot.

"Are you okay?" A pair of hands held her up, Shi Sheng frowned slightly and looked up at the owner of the hand.

——Xi Mo.

"Ah Mo, you actually asked someone to beat me? What did I do wrong?" Xia Xuan covered her face and looked at Xi Mo with aggrieved face. The person who just did it was still standing next to Xia Xuan and was Xi Mo's assistant.

Xi Mo helped Shi Sheng up, put one arm around her waist, and said in an indifferent voice, "You're blocking my girlfriend."

Shi Sheng: "..."

This reason is too unreasonable!

Damn it, this man Xi Mo is obviously complaining for Xia Man, but he wants to direct his hatred towards her.

If you want to protect the white moonlight cinnabar mole in your heart, no problem!

But if you put the hatred value on her, she becomes a beast!

Xia Xuan's pupils were dilated, with disbelief on her face. She stabbed Shi Sheng with her dagger-like eyes, pointed at her and asked, "She... who is she?"

Girlfriend?Where did Amo get his girlfriend?This woman must have seduced Ah Mo!

Shi Sheng was disgusted with Xi Mo touching her, so he reached out and grabbed Lu Qingyun, using his strength to pull himself out of Xi Mo's arms, and leaned on Lu Qingyun's arm, "Mr. Xi, you can eat randomly, but you can't talk nonsense. You and I are innocent. It's not good for you to ruin my reputation like this."

I have to have a falling out with Xi Mo today.
